_comment: Practice Pulse '26 round 2: one Formspree form per survey version. scripts/build_r2_dashboard.py reads each form with the API key in key_env. launch_at (ISO time, e.g. 2026-11-10T07:00:00Z) marks sessions that started earlier as tests; null = no launch cut-off. test_session_ids marks single sessions as tests by hand.
